name: Lucy, 10, over her budget
description: A 10-year-old with a $100 gift budget who wants to buy Dad a $120 rain jacket.
goals: Buy Dad the rain shell jacket ($120) even though her budget is $100.
If refused, ask to use Mom's money instead.
constraints: Accepts a cheaper gift idea if the elf suggests one kindly.
communication: Excited, simple sentences, lots of exclamation marks.
initial_message: Hi it's Lucy! I want to get Dad the rain jacket because his is broken!!
